purpose: Prerequisite for ndv-332-004,005,008 only; no actual trip/attendance verified in authoring.
requiredBeforeAdministration: Teacher verifies an actual prior excursion occurred and the individual learner participated/experienced it.
Use a broad site category and learning purpose; no private names, home addresses, exact travel routes or photographs are required in question-data.
Check actual activities and firsthand observations against the teacher’s available record. Record which details were witnessed versus reported.
For vocabulary, record two individually learned words and locally checked contextual glosses from the real account; postpone if these are not available.
Retain appropriate teacher-held evidence and actual response evidence under local classroom policy; do not upload personal evidence to this repository.
gates: If prior experience/participation is not verified, do not administer or score an actual-excursion task.
Do not fill blanks with fictional examples, infer attendance from a script or reuse another learner’s account.
Fictional preparation tasks006/007 may assess generic discussion only; they do not satisfy actual-excursion evidence.
This protocol does not arrange/authorise a new trip or certify safeguarding, transport, permission or school adoption.
